messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Submitting suggestions to docs
parts:
I would like to help out with improving the docs (http://docs.renjin.org/en/latest/, particularly the section on writing extensions right now). However, the docs does not seem to be in the renjin repo on github (unless I managed to miss it). What would the process be for this? What format should I use and where (to who) do I send suggestions?

Best regards,
Per

messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: Submitting suggestions to docs
parts:
Hi Per,

you should find the "Edit on GitHub" link at the top of each chapter. The chapter on writing extensions will take you here: https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-docs/blob/master/source/writing-renjin-extensions.rst. Note that the sources are written in reStructuredText.

We very much welcome your contribution to the documentation.  The section on the hamcrest package also needs to be extended to cover additional matcher functions for errors, throwsError(), and warnings, emitsWarning(). We have an issue open for that: https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-docs/issues/5.

Regards,

Maarten-Jan
